newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:
Spokesman Thierry Daman confirmed that Commissioner Emma Bonino was visiting Iraq, dealing with humanitarian issues. The visit would last for several days, he said.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/738: Temporary ban on imports of fishery products from Bangladesh, India and Madagascar.
- IP/97/: Aid of 17 million Ecus for a development project in the Orange Free State.
- IP/97/: Decisions to clear standard distribution agreements of the Ford service outlet and the "Smart" car.
